jsdelivr.purpose: Load transit API provider definitions from the public-transport/transport-apis registry
jsdelivr.dataReceived: Provider configs with name, protocol type, coverage area (GeoJSON), endpoint URL, auth config, products

github.purpose: Fallback for loading transit registry when JSDelivr is unavailable
github.dataReceived: Same provider config JSON as JSDelivr

regional-operators.purpose: Regional public-transport stop and departure APIs from the transport-apis registry.
regional-operators.dataSent: Nearby coordinates and radius, stop names or IDs and departure time window; no account or device identifier.

stadtnavi.purpose: Find stops and retrieve departure boards from the reviewed regional OTP provider.
stadtnavi.dataSent: Nearby coordinates and radius, stop names or stop IDs and requested departure time window; no account/device identifier.
stadtnavi.dataReceived: Stops, scheduled departures, reported realtime estimates and cancellations.
